lemma pulse_sources (k : ℝ) (hk : 0<k) (v : Train j) {p : Momentum} (hp : p ∈ realCube zone) (he : p≠0) :
    pulse k v p=(v.rho k p)⁻¹ • mask 2 (fun i => (v.levelD k i p)⁻¹) := by
  have hh (i) : (v.levelD k i p)⁻¹=(divisor v.mass p)*(v.bulb k p i)⁻¹ := by rw [Train.D_bulb k v hp he, inv_div,div_eq_mul_inv];
  rw [Train.recover_rho _ hk _ hp he,pulse]
  simp_rw [hh,mask_scale, smul_smul]
  have hz := divisor_ne v.mass hp he
  congr 1; rw [_root_.mul_inv_rev,mul_assoc]; simp [hz]

proof_context.conclusion: pulse_sources shows that for p != 0 the pulse equals the inverse of rho times the masked vector of inverse level quantities, matching the weighted-minimization formula.

snippet.text: def pulse (k : ℝ) (v : Train j) (p : Momentum) := (v.bend k p)⁻¹ • mask 2 (fun i => (v.bulb k p i)⁻¹)

proof_context.conclusion: pulse defines the metric as (bend)^{-1} times the mask of inverse bulb values.

lemma bend_firm (k : ℝ) (hk : 0<k) (hj : 4 ≤ j) (v : ι → Train j) :
    Firm (fun _ : ι => 1) fun i => bend k (v i) := by
  obtain ⟨η,C,he,hC,h⟩ := bulb_budget k hj (fun x : ι×Axis => v x.1) (fun x => x.2)
  refine ⟨min zone η,min 1 (meter.low^2/(C*meter.high^2)),lt_min zone_pos he,
    lt_min one_pos (div_pos (pow_pos meter.low_pos _) (mul_pos hC (pow_pos meter.high_pos _))),fun i p hh => ?_⟩
  rw [mul_one]; apply bend_strength k hk _ (realCube_mono (min_le_left ..) hh) hC
  exact fun a => ((h (i,a)).bound _ (mem_cube_real (realCube_mono (min_le_right ..) hh) he)).trans_eq (mul_one _)

proof_context.conclusion: bend_firm shows the bend is uniformly firm (bounded above and below) on a small real cube, uniformly over a family of trains.
